numbers.title: ABNs and ACNs
numbers.description: The numbers to check. Spaces, dashes and dots are ignored. An 11 digit number is treated as an ABN and a 9 digit number as an ACN unless you choose a number type below. Up to 10,000 numbers per run.

numberType.title: Number type
numberType.description: Auto detects by length. Choose ABN or ACN to force one type and get a clear error for numbers of the wrong length.
